## EDB27849 [(TM621761)](http://www.trismegistos.org/tm/detail.php?quick=621761)
| Incertae originis |
| [Titulus sepulchralis](https://www.eagle-network.eu/voc/typeins/lod/92) |
| Now Lost |
| _Date:_ 398; 399 |
| _Edition(s):_ ICVR I, 309; ILCV, |
| 4400B |
| _Other bibliography:_ CLRE, |
| 661 |
|  |
| ((monogramma Christi cum alpha et omega)) benemerenti in pace [---] |
| quae vixit annus quatur [menses --- me?]mor filiae dulcissimae deposita[e in pace ] |
| septimum kalendas septembris die Veneris [post?] |
| consulatu d(omini) n(ostri) Harchadi IIII et Euty- |
| chiani v(iri) c(larissimi) cons(ulibu)s |
| AC |
|  |
| Transcription different from ICVR. 2. [--- a]mor, Silvagni in ICVR. The integration here proposed, --- me]mor, are reprised by E. Diehl (ILCV ad loc. cit.). 5. Harchadi pro Honori: "... Monuit iam Muratori sive quadratarii sive eius, qui lapidem descripsit, vitio, Arcadi pro Honorii nomen hic esse suppositum" (Silvagni, ICVR ad loc. cit.) (Felle). CLRE editors assigned the inscription to 398, since, despite the fact that the 26th of August occurred on Friday in 399, "days are often wrong, or at least do not match dates; and there is not example of the p.c. so late in 399. Moreover, the restoration of post or even p would be rather long for the place" (Vilella after CLRE, ad loc. cit.). |
|  |
| Filippo Piazzolla, 07/02/2013 |
| Last update by Antonello Vilella on 10/04/2021 |
| Report a problem |

## EDB28939 [(TM622140)](http://www.trismegistos.org/tm/detail.php?quick=622140)
| Incertae originis |
| [Titulus sepulchralis](https://www.eagle-network.eu/voc/typeins/lod/92) [insculptus](https://www.eagle-network.eu/voc/writing/lod/1) |
| [Sarcophagus](https://www.eagle-network.eu/voc/objtyp/lod/214) |
| Now Lost |
| _Date:_ 403 |
| _Edition(s):_ ICVR I, 713; ILCV, |
| 4744 |
|  |
| quod dulcis nati quod cara pignera praestant |
| continet hic tumulus membra qui parva retentat |
| dolorem sine fine dedit Felicitas isto |
| clauditur infelix falso cognomine dicta |
| nam cui prima dies in lucem protulit annus |
| quattuor et male cum quintum sumeret ortum |
| abstulit atra dies et funere mersit acervo |
| haec mater et genitor conscribunt carmina busto |
| - |
| ((orans puella)) |
| - |
| quo legenti simul redeat sub corde figura |
| et siccato saepe madescant lumina fletu |
| sic medicatur amor nec curant carmina manes |
| dep(osita) in p(ace) die kal(endas) iulias (!) |
| d(omino) n(ostro) Theodosio Aug(usto) et Fl(avio) Rumorido |
| v(iro) c(larissimo) cons(ulibu)s |
|  |
| 5ex. 'annus' = 'annos'; 7. Verg. Aen. VI, 429; Aen. XI, 28; 7ex.: 'acervo' = 'acerbo'; 12ex. 'kal(endas) iulias' = 'kalendis iuliis'. |
|  |
| Filippo Piazzolla, 26/02/2013 |
| Last update by Antonio Enrico Felle on 17/03/2014 |
